claim: Take an account that withdraws only the required minimum from age 73 (balance divided by the Uniform Lifetime Table divisor) and earns a constant real return equal to the 20-year TIPS yield. The first withdrawal is 3.77% of the starting balance. At the latest yield (3.14% real, 28 September 2026) the inflation-adjusted withdrawal rises every year until age 93, reaching 5.44% of the starting balance, and at 90 the account still holds 65.9% of its starting real value while paying 5.4%. At the series low (-0.76%, 9 November 2021) the same rules shrink real withdrawals in every year after 73 (0 rising years), to 2.8% at 90, with 34.2% of the real balance left. Whether minimum withdrawals feel like a shrinking or a growing income is set by real yields, not by the table alone.

numbers.definition: Last non-missing daily value in the DFII20 file (20-year Treasury inflation-indexed constant-maturity yield, percent), dated 2026-09-28.
Minimum daily DFII20 value in the file (2004-07-27 to 2026-09-28).

Simulation: start balance B73 = 1 (real) at age 73. Each age a = 73..100: withdrawal W_a = B_a / D_a at the start of the year, where D_a is the Uniform Lifetime Table divisor (73: 26.5 ... 100: 6.4); then B_{a+1} = (B_a - W_a) x (1 + r/100), r = constant real yield. This number = W_73 x 100 (independent of r).
Age a in 73..100 with the largest W_a when r = real_yield_now_pct.
W at now_peak_withdrawal_age x 100, r = real_yield_now_pct.
Count of ages a in 74..100 with W_a > W_{a-1} when r = real_yield_low_pct.

assumptions: The account earns a constant real return equal to the 20-year TIPS yield on the chosen date for all years (as if locked in with inflation-protected bonds); no taxes, fees, or extra withdrawals.
Owner starts required distributions at 73 (born 1951-1959) and uses the Uniform Lifetime Table (spouse not more than 10 years younger or not the sole beneficiary).
Withdrawal happens at the start of each year; balances and withdrawals are in constant (inflation-adjusted) dollars.

provisions.quote: In the case of an individual who attains age 72 after December 31, 2022, and age 73 before January 1, 2033, the applicable age is 73.
